mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own vessels was most worthwhile: the explanation distinguishes blood inside the chambers from the supply needed by the heart muscle.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive route connections felt somewhat repetitive because each was the only offered combination, although they made the two loops clear.

surprise.text: I found it useful that chamber blood alone cannot feed the heart’s thick muscle; the coronary vessels provide a separate tissue supply.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the forced sequence gave me little opportunity to decide how the circulation should be assembled.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how circulation supports the arm, but I would hope for more meaningful choices. The descriptions explain the structures clearly, though the planned illustrations cannot yet be judged visually.
